description: Source code for a Python module that generates and converts operation graphs into executable code for testing PyTorch operations, including support for DTensor and placement strategies.

classes.name: FuzzTemplate
classes.description: Base class for generating code templates for different operation sets and configurations.

classes.name: DefaultFuzzTemplate
classes.description: Default template supporting a wide range of PyTorch operations, tensor and scalar specs.

classes.name: DTensorFuzzTemplate
classes.description: Template for generating code with DTensor support, including distributed setup.

classes.name: UnbackedFuzzTemplate
classes.description: Template for generating code with unbacked tensors, supporting data-dependent operations.

classes.name: DTensorFuzzPlacementsTemplate
classes.description: Extension of DTensorFuzzTemplate with randomized placement strategies.

methods.name: convert_graph_to_python_code
methods.description: Converts an operation graph into executable Python code with topological order, supporting different templates and seed for reproducibility.

methods.name: generate_simple_operation_code
methods.description: Generates code lines for executing a single operation based on its name and output specification.

methods.name: create_program_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary Python file from generated code for execution.
